svg.text: Request: “PDB entry 2NWD: the LYZ (Lysozyme C, UniProt P61626) variant p.W82R is classified as pathogenic in ClinVar. Show the
residue it replaces as yellow spacefill spheres.”
The three drawings as Mol* 5.9.0 renders them, from one camera. Below: how each is graded.
Trp64 of chain X as yellow spacefill. Nothing else. Table
1 fact: the 24 atoms of Trp64, yellow spacefill
Recall (share of the reference the answer has)
Precision (share of the answer the reference has)
Answer A: number copied from the variant name
Author residue 82 drawn. It is Ser82, another residue.
1 fact: the 11 atoms of Ser82, yellow spacefill
Recall (share of the reference the answer has)
Precision (share of the answer the reference has)
Answer B: right residue, extra context
The right residue, plus a grey cartoon of the whole
protein that the request does not ask for. Table 3, row
fact 1: Trp64, grey cartoon and yellow spacefill;
one of its two styles is in the reference: 0.5
fact 2: all other residues, grey cartoon;
none of it is in the reference: 0
Recall (share of the reference the answer has)
Precision, the mean over the two facts: (0.5 + 0) / 2
